DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何かお困りでしょうか。足元が見えにくそうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having any trouble? It looks as though you cannot see where you are stepping very well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 眼鏡を友達に持ってもらったまま、友達が先に帰り始めました。遠くが見えにくいので、追いかけるのが不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先に帰る友人が自分眼鏡を所持し追跡歩行が不安と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend was holding my glasses for me and has started heading home ahead of me. I cannot see well at a distance, so I am worried about following them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the friend heading home ahead of you has your glasses, and that you feel uneasy about walking after them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まずこちらで立ち止まってください。お友達へ連絡はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please stop here first. Can you contact your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 電話できます。走って追うより、眼鏡を持って戻ってもらおうと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 電話可能で走らず眼鏡を持って戻るよう頼むと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can phone them. Instead of running after them, I think I will ask them to come back with my glasses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you can call and will ask your friend to return with your glasses instead of running after them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今いる場所を伝えて、動く方を決めるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to tell them where you are and agree on who will move.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。入口と言うだけでは広いので、この案内板の前と伝えます。友達も分かる場所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広い入口でなく共通目印の案内板前を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. The entrance is too broad a description, so I will say I am in front of this information board. My friend knows this spot too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the shared landmark in front of the information board rather than the broad location of the entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ほかの方の通行を妨げない位置でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait somewhere that does not block other people passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。ベンチまで移る前に足元を確かめます。友達には場所を変える時も連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 足元確認と待機位置変更時の連絡をすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will check where I am stepping before moving to the bench. I will also contact my friend if I change where I am waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your footing and notify your friend whenever you change your waiting location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 無理に歩かず、お困りの時は職員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not force yourself to walk. Please let a staff member know if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ここから電話して、戻ってもらえるか確かめます。眼鏡を受け取ってから一緒に帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: その場で電話し眼鏡受取後に共に帰ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will call from here and check whether my friend can come back. Once I have my glasses, we will go home together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will phone from where you are and go home together after receiving your glasses. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらで落ち着いてお待ちください。お帰りの際はお気をつけて。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please wait here calmly. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物から音がしたようですが、お困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: I thought I heard a sound from your luggage. Are you having trouble?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 椅子へ置いた時に、箱の中でぱきっと音がしました。買った陶器が入っているので、割れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 待機椅子へ陶器箱を置いた時の破損疑いの音を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I put the box on the chair, I heard a crack inside it. It contains pottery I bought, so it might have broken.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a sound suggesting breakage when you placed a box of pottery on a waiting-area chair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱の外へ破片が出たり、けがをしたりしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have any fragments come out of the box, or have you been injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: けがはありません。箱は閉じています。ここで開けて、素手で探すのはやめておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無傷で閉箱のまま素手探索をしないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not injured. The box is closed. I will avoid opening it here and feeling around with my bare hands.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you are uninjured, that the box remains closed, and that you will not search inside with bare hands. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、荷物を落ち着いて持てる場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us keep the passage clear and find somewhere you can hold your luggage steadily.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。急いで列車へ走ると、箱の中でまた動くと思います。先に持ち方を考えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 急走せず箱内移動を抑える持ち方を考えたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. If I rush and run for the train, I think things will move around inside the box again. I would like to work out how to carry it first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to avoid rushing and consider how to carry the box to limit movement inside it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入したお店の梱包について、確認できる案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have any instructions from the shop about its packaging?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 包み方の紙があります。駅員の方に修理を頼むのではなく、安全に持ち帰れる状態か、店にも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店の梱包紙を示し駅修理でなく持帰状態を店へ相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a sheet about how it was wrapped. Rather than asking station staff to repair it, I will also consult the shop about whether it is safe to take home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the shop's packaging instructions and say you will consult the shop about its condition for taking home, rather than seek repairs at the station. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 駅では、周りを汚したり危険を生じさせたりしないようお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: While at the station, please carry it in a way that does not dirty the surroundings or create a hazard.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。箱を閉じたまま支えて、店へ電話します。破片が出るようなら乗る前にもう一度お知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 閉箱を支え店へ連絡し外部破片なら再報告すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will support the closed box and phone the shop. If fragments start coming out, I will let you know again before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will support the closed box, contact the shop, and report again if fragments come out. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、お荷物と足元に気をつけてください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please take care with your luggage and watch your step. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座のご参加についてでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about participation in a course?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。昨日の回を休みました。次の回についていけるよう、配った資料を受け取れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 欠席講座の次回理解用に配布資料を受取れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I missed yesterday's session. I would like to ask whether I can receive the handouts so I can keep up at the next session.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can receive the handouts from the course session you missed to help you understand the next one. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 講座名と、お申し込みのお名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please give me the course name and the name you registered under.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この講座です。休んだのは私で、家族が代わりに参加したわけでもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 講座名申込者を示し家族代理出席もなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this course. I was the one who was absent, and no family member attended in my place either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Identify the course and registrant, and explain that no family member attended as a substitute. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 資料のお渡しについて、講座の担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will ask the course coordinator about providing the handouts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。資料をもらえた場合でも、昨日出席したことにはしなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資料受領で過去出席扱いに変更する希望はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Even if I receive the handouts, there is no need to count me as having attended yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that receiving the materials does not mean you want your past absence changed to attendance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 出席についても、実際の状況を担当へ伝えます。次の回に参加する予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also tell the coordinator what actually happened regarding attendance. Do you plan to join the next session?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。資料に書いてある課題があれば、次までに何を準備するかも知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回出席予定で課題等の事前準備を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. If there is an assignment in the materials, I would also like to know what to prepare before next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you plan to attend next time and ask about advance preparation, including assignments. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備についての質問を合わせて担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass your preparation questions to the coordinator as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。昨日の内容を全部窓口で教えてもらうのではなく、資料と準備の案内を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 窓口で講義再現を求めず資料準備案内を確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will check the materials and preparation instructions, rather than asking you to teach me all of yesterday's content here at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the materials and preparation guidance without asking the counter staff to repeat the lecture. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当へおつなぎします。次回の講座をお楽しみください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will put you in touch with the coordinator. Enjoy the next session. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察前の準備で、お手伝いできることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything I can help you with as you prepare for your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 厚い上着と大きな袋があります。診察室でどこへ置けばよいか、入る前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 厚手上着と大袋の診察室内置場を事前相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a thick coat and a large bag. Before going in, I would like to ask where I should put them in the consulting room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in advance where to place a thick coat and a large bag in the consulting room. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご自身の荷物は、どれでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋と上着です。袋には買った食品が入っています。通路や診察の道具の所へ置かないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 食品袋と上着が自己荷物で通路機器を避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This bag and coat. The bag contains food I bought. I want to avoid putting them in the passage or by the examination equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the food bag and coat are yours and that you want to keep them away from walkways and equipment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 置き方は診察室の担当に確認してください。今は手元にまとめてお持ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please ask the staff in the consulting room where to place them. Can you keep them together with you for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。上着の中に財布もあるので、上着だけを離れた所に置き忘れないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 上着に財布があり離置忘失を防ぐと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My wallet is in my coat too, so I will take care not to leave just the coat somewhere away from me and forget it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your wallet is in your coat and that you will prevent leaving the coat elsewhere and forgetting it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物が重い場合は、移動の前に職員へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: If your luggage is heavy, please tell a staff member before moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。運ぶのはできます。呼ばれたら全部持って入り、どこへ置くか担当に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運搬自力可で呼出後全荷物持参し担当へ置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I can carry it. When called, I will take everything inside and ask the staff where to put it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you can carry everything yourself and will take all your belongings in when called, then ask the staff where to put them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 脱いだ上着についても、ご案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the instructions about the coat you take off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に物を机の上へ広げず、置く場所を聞いてから準備します。帰る時も袋と上着を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 勝手に机へ広げず置場確認後準備し退出時二品点検すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not spread things on the desk first; I will ask where to put them before getting ready. I will also check for both my bag and coat when leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not spread things on the desk without asking, will prepare after checking where to put them, and will check both items when leaving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、荷物をお持ちのまま診察までお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep your belongings with you and wait for your consultation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちの紙について、ご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss the paper you are holding?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の自転車のかごに入っていました。強い言葉が書いてあって、誰が入れたか分からず不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自転車かごの強い言葉の紙を発見し入れ手不明で相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It was in my bicycle basket. It has harsh words written on it, and I am anxious because I do not know who put it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice after finding a note with harsh wording in your bicycle basket, with no knowledge of who placed it there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつ、どこで気づきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: When and where did you notice it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の夕方、買い物から戻った時です。店の駐輪場所で、入れた人は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夕方店駐輪場で買物後発見し投入は未目撃と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This evening, when I returned from shopping. It was in the shop's bicycle parking area, and I did not see who put it there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you found it after shopping in the shop's bicycle parking area in the evening and did not witness it being placed there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書かれている内容を確認します。ほかに同じようなことはありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what it says. Has anything similar happened before?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紙は初めてです。以前の傷も気になっていますが、今日の紙を書いた人が付けた傷とは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初回紙と過去傷の関連は不明と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the first note. I am also concerned about an earlier scratch, but I do not know whether the person who wrote today's note made that scratch.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the first note from the earlier scratch, whose connection to it is unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 関係が確かめられていないことは、分けてお聞きします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will ask separately about things whose connection has not been established.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。紙は書き足さずに持ってきました。知っている人を疑っていますが、証拠があるわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未加筆原紙を示し知人への疑いは証拠なしと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I brought the paper without adding anything to it. I suspect someone I know, but I do not have evidence.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the original paper with no additions and say that your suspicion of an acquaintance is not supported by evidence. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お気持ちと、確認できた出来事を分けてご説明ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please distinguish your feelings from events you have confirmed when explaining.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。誰かの名前を犯人として広めず、発見した場所と時刻、紙の状態からお話しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人物名を犯人として拡散せず発見事実から説明すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not spread anyone's name as the culprit. I will start with where and when I found it and the condition of the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not circulate anyone's name as the culprit and will explain the facts of the discovery first. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、内容を確認します。お帰りの際もお気をつけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will check the contents. Please also take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 手作りのカードをお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send a handmade card, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。開くと家の形が立ち上がります。閉じても少し厚いので、普通の紙一枚と同じ扱いか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 立体家が起立する手製カードの閉時厚さを発送相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. When opened, a house shape pops up. It is still a little thick when closed, so I do not know whether it is treated like a single ordinary sheet of paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending a handmade card with a pop-up house, including its thickness when closed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 包装した状態の大きさや厚さを確認しましょう。まだ封はしていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check its size and thickness when packaged. Have you left it unsealed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: していません。家の部分を強く押すと折れそうなので、無理に薄くする前に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未封緘で押しつぶして薄くする前に確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it is not sealed. Pressing hard on the house might fold it, so I will ask before trying to force it thinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it is unsealed and that you will check before squashing it to reduce the thickness. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: つぶれにくい包装と、利用できる発送方法をご検討ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider packaging that resists crushing and the shipping methods available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。中の家を外すと作品が変わるので、そのまま送れる包装を探したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家部品を外さず作品形を保つ包装を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please help me with that. Removing the house inside would change the work, so I would like to find packaging that lets me send it as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request packaging that preserves the work's form without removing the house component. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 用意できる材料や、外側の寸法を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check the materials available and the outside dimensions before advising you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。カードの寸法だけでなく、保護する物を入れた後の大きさも見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保護材追加後の外寸も確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will look at the size after adding protective materials, as well as the dimensions of the card itself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will also check the outside dimensions after protective materials have been added. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内容品と包装が決まってから、料金を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the fee after you have settled on the contents and packaging.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。先に切手だけ買わず、形を守る包装を整えてから送り方を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 切手先買いでなく包装完成後に発送方式を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will not buy stamps first. I will arrange packaging that protects its shape, then choose how to send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose the shipping method after finishing the packaging instead of buying stamps beforehand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、包装のご相談からご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will start by advising you about packaging. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日はどのようなご質問がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What questions do you have today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先月分の取引明細を頼みたいです。質問は何点かありますが、まず持ち物と受け取り方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先月取引明細の準備物と受取方法を優先して尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to request a transaction statement for last month. I have several questions, but first please tell me what to bring and how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Prioritize asking what to prepare and how to collect last month's transaction statement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先に口座を確認します。通帳かカードと、ご本人確認のできるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: First I will check your account. Do you have your passbook or card and something that verifies your identity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通帳と本人確認の書類を持っています。必要なのは先月の一か月分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通帳本人確認書類の所持と対象一か月を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my passbook and identification documents. I need the whole of last month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you have your passbook and identification documents and specify the one-month period required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その期間で確認します。明細のお渡しは、内容を確認した後にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check that period. We will explain collection of the statement after checking the details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日持ち帰れるか知りたいです。まだ分からないなら、受け取りの日を聞いてから予定を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 当日受取可否を尋ね未確定なら案内後に予定を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to know whether I can take it home today. If that is not yet known, I will make my plans after hearing the collection date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether same-day collection is possible and say that, if it is not yet decided, you will make plans after receiving the information. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お渡しまでの時間と費用も確認します。今、ほかに急ぐご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will also check the time needed and the cost. Do you have any other urgent questions now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の申込みで必要なのは、その二つです。来月以降の利用の質問は、今日は後にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日必須二問を優先し将来利用質問は後日にすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Those two points are what I need for today's application. I will leave questions about using the service from next month onward for another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will prioritize the two questions essential today and postpone questions about future use to another day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。確認したい期間を用紙へご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please enter the period you want checked on the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先月の初日から末日までを書きます。記入できたら、通帳と書類をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象月の初末日を記入し通帳確認書類を提示すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write the first through the last day of last month. Once I have filled it in, I will show you my passbook and documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will enter the first and last dates of the month concerned and present your passbook and identification documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お持ちの資料から確認します。ご準備ありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will start by checking the materials you brought. Thank you for preparing them. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの食器で、どのような使い方をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: How are you planning to use this tableware?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 料理を温めて、食洗機で洗いたいです。隣の皿と形が似ていますが、同じように使えるか見てほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 温めと食洗機洗浄の両用途で類似食器の適合を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to heat food in it and wash it in the dishwasher. It looks similar to the plate beside it, but I would like you to check whether I can use it the same way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether similar-looking tableware is suitable for both heating food and dishwasher cleaning. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この商品の取扱表示を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check this product's care markings.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。電子レンジのマークらしい物はありますが、食洗機についての字がまだ読めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: レンジらしいマークと未読食洗機表示を分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please. There is something that looks like a microwave symbol, but I have not yet read the wording about dishwashers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out separately the apparent microwave symbol and the dishwasher wording you have not yet read. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの使い方は、別の項目としてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the two uses as separate items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。温められると分かっただけで、洗い方も同じとは思わず、両方の表示を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 温め対応のみから洗浄適合を推論せず二項確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check both markings without assuming that finding out it can be heated means the washing method is the same too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will check both items without inferring dishwasher suitability merely from heating suitability. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入後に見直せる説明は、こちらにも付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Instructions you can refer to again after purchase are also included here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。表示のシールをすぐ捨てず、商品名と一緒に残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 購入後再確認用に表示と商品名を残したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I would like to keep the label along with the product name instead of throwing the sticker away immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to keep the markings and product name for checking again after purchase. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご不明な表示は、メーカーの案内もお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also check the manufacturer's guidance about any markings you do not understand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そうします。今日は二つの用途が確認できる物を選び、隣の皿の説明と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 両用途確認済商品を選び別商品の説明を混ぜないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Today I will choose something confirmed for both uses and avoid mixing its instructions up with those for the plate beside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will choose a product confirmed for both uses and will not mix up explanations for different products. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、商品の表示をご覧ください。お買い物をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please look at the product markings. Enjoy your shopping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地面の絵について、お話しできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Can you tell me about the drawing on the ground?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもがチョークで描きました。描いてよい場所か確認していなかったので、どう対応したらよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未確認場所で子供チョーク画を描いたと事後相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child drew it in chalk. I had not checked whether drawing was allowed here, so I would like to ask what I should do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice after your child drew in chalk at a place whose rules you had not checked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どこに描いて、どの道具を使いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did they draw, and what tools did they use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この舗装の所です。このチョークで、絵の具は使っていません。もう描くのは止めました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 舗装位置とチョークのみ使用と停止済を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: On this paved area. With this chalk; no paint was used. They have already stopped drawing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the paved location, that only chalk was used, and that drawing has stopped. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が状態を確認します。ご自身で水などをかける前にお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check its condition. Please wait before pouring water or anything else on it yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。消えると思って水を流すと、通る人の足元もぬれてしまいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己流水消去で通路を濡らさず待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If I run water over it thinking it will come off, I will also wet the ground where people walk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait instead of wetting the walkway by running water to erase it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お子さんには、ほかの場所へも描かないようお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell your child not to draw in other places either.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 伝えます。描いた範囲が分かるように説明し、私も一緒に確認を受けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加描画を止め範囲説明と保護者同席確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will. I would like to explain the area drawn on and be present with my child while it is checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will stop further drawing, explain its extent, and request that the guardian be present during the check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な対応を担当からご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will explain what action is needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。きれいになったと勝手に言って帰らず、案内を聞いてから対応します。次は場所を先に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己原状回復済とせず指示対応し次回事前確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please. I will not decide on my own that it is clean and leave. I will follow the guidance after hearing it. Next time I will check the location first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not declare the site restored yourself, will follow the instructions, and will check beforehand next time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、担当に確認します。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will check with the person in charge. Please wait here. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この案内図について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about this map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飛行機の絵があるので、ここから空港へ電車で直接行けるのかと思いました。絵の意味を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 案内飛行機絵から空港直通と考え表示意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a picture of an airplane, so I thought a train might go directly from here to the airport. I would like to check what the picture means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you inferred a direct airport service from the airplane picture and ask what the symbol means. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 目的の施設はお決まりですか。それとも空港への移動をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you decided on a facility to visit, or are you looking for transport to the airport?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 空港へ行きたいです。展示施設を見る予定ではありません。この絵だけで乗る列車を決めかけました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展示施設でなく空港希望で絵のみ乗車決定しかけたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to go to the airport. I am not planning to visit an exhibition facility. I nearly chose a train based only on this picture.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your destination is the airport rather than an exhibition facility and that you nearly chose a train from the picture alone. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この飛行機の絵は、航空機を展示する施設の場所を示しています。空港へ直通する列車の印ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This airplane picture shows the location of a facility that exhibits aircraft. It does not indicate a train going directly to the airport.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 展示の施設の印なのですね。意味が分かったので、今度は自分の空港への経路を調べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図の航空機展示施設表示を理解し空港への実経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it marks an exhibition facility. Now that I understand it, I would like to look up the route to my airport.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the aircraft exhibition facility symbol and ask for the actual route to the airport. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用する空港の名前と、出発したい時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell me the name of the airport you will use and the time you want to leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この予約にある空港で、午前中に出たいです。飛行機の出発時刻と、ここを出る時刻は別に考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約空港と午前出発希望を示し航空発と駅発を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the airport on this booking, and I would like to leave in the morning. I will consider the flight departure time separately from the time I leave here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the airport on your booking, state your wish to depart in the morning, and distinguish flight departure from station departure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 現在の交通案内と、必要な乗り換えをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check current transport information and any necessary transfers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。案内図の絵の所へ歩く前に、空港名と経路を確かめます。間に合うかも実際の時刻で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 図示場所へ向かわず空港経路時刻を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Before walking toward the place marked by the picture on the map, I will check the airport name and route. I will also use the actual times to check whether I can make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the airport, route, and times before heading to the location pictured on the map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、交通の案内をご確認ください。お気をつけてお出かけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check the transport information. Have a safe journey.
